usg.text: Jhoira leaves the Ghitu of Shiv to learn artifice, befriends Karn and gives him his name.

When Kerrick uses her to infiltrate the Academy, the Tolarian Temporal Disaster strands her on Tolaria for ten years, though she saves Teferi, and she becomes nearly immortal by drinking time-rift water.
Urza, Barrin and Karn later return to Tolaria and reestablish the Academy with her aid.
Urza then completes the skyship, christens it the Weatherlight and names Jhoira its Captain and Karn Master of Engines.

ulg.text: In Urza's Legacy, Jhoira and Karn help Urza survey the Thran Mana Rig in Shiv and uncover its primary purpose.
On her last mission as captain of the Weatherlight she takes refugees from Serra's Realm to Zhalfir, and when Teferi proposes to her she turns him down to live her own life and return to Shiv.

tsp.text: In Time Spiral, Teferi and Jhoira return to Dominaria with Shiv's return imminent, seeking information and aid in a land nearly devoid of mana.
In Urborg they meet Venser, and when his demonstration of the ambulator makes the rift react violently, the whole group is pulled through it.
Jhoira negotiates a truce between the Ghitu and goblins fighting over the Rig and repairs it, and she travels with Venser to the Ghitu where he perfects his throne device.
Teferi, helped by Jhoira, restores Shiv to the timeline and seals the rift, sacrificing his spark, and at the end the group disbands as Jhoira goes to seek Jodah.

tsb.text: On the cards of Time Spiral Timeshifted, Jhoira is remembered as a master artificer.

dgm.text: Jhoira appears in Dragon's Maze as an artificer who works thirty hours straight on a spell, etching its amplification circle and leaving a note beside a crystal sphere.
When she learns that barbarians plan to kill her and her companions in a solstice ritual, she fights Grell with flame bolts and an ant-shaped construct, and her spell teleports him away.
Her note, signed by her, announces her victory.

dom.text: In Dominaria, Jhoira finds the wreck of the Weatherlight on the sea floor and, sixty years after the Mending, raises it, restores it with a new hull seed and assembles a crew against Belzenlok's Cabal.
Tiana is moved to recognize the ship as Gerrard's blade and revives its Powerstone, and Jhoira recruits Shanna, Raff and the vampire Arvad, who swears to serve her.
Ajani tells her that Karn was rescued from the Phyrexians, and the Weatherlight's crew learns of the Blackblade as Jhoira offers the ship to help destroy Belzenlok.
Jhoira has been keeping Teferi's planeswalker spark in a Powerstone, and she shows him the locket and drops it into his palm, saying "Welcome back," so he can help kill Bolas.

m21.text: On the cards of Core Set 2021, Jhoira is the one who gave Teferi a crystal that may have been a blessing or a curse.

mbc.text: On the cards of Mystery Booster Commander Edition, Jhoira is a master artificer who describes mana as possibility not yet given form.
